chapter.title: Chapter 1 - Northbound Second Street
chapter.tone: sunset parking-lot odyssey with escalating freeway shadow and a comic BMX finale

establishing_shot.camera_note: Begin deep in the setback with parked-car rows, palms, cart corral, green storefront massing, and the distant northbound road.

major_fights.title: Cart Return Basics
major_fights.completion_note: Unlocks the cart interaction prompt after the first clean hit, without a full-screen tutorial panel.

major_fights.title: Town & Country Alarm
major_fights.completion_note: A car alarm, pulsing hazard lights, and a rolling delivery van change the arena read before the final wave.

major_fights.title: El Cilantro Corner
major_fights.completion_note: The corner locks only long enough for a meaningful route climax, then opens to the Jerry story beat.

ambush_or_optional.title: Wells Service Alley
ambush_or_optional.reward: BB tin or Super Butane cache plus score multiplier
ambush_or_optional.risk: narrow exit, alley rusher, and a time-costing side fight

environmental_events.description: A smoking sidewalk tent and a low cart shelter open the Sprouts lane right at the opening stretch so the new homeless ambush is visible immediately.
A marked cart can be pushed, thrown, or used as lane cover, and returns safely after the encounter.
A pair of smoking sidewalk tents and a low shopping cart shelter force the lane open before the Town & Country fight.
An alarm, vehicle hazard lights, and a slow delivery-van pass make the middle fight escalate without blocking the route.

story_beats.description: Jerry gets a staged, skippable edge-of-screen arrival at El Cilantro and points the party toward the 7-Eleven clue.

landmark_set_pieces.description: Madison traffic, corner curb geometry, Goodwill massing, and the El Cilantro facade create a real level ending rather than a repeated storefront.

traversal_gaps.description: A driveway and temporary vehicle lane require a short depth weave with clear ground markers and no dead-end collision.

ending.visual: El Cilantro corner settles into a warm store-light silhouette while the party faces north.
ending.narrative: Jerry's clue turns the next destination into a visible 7-Eleven lead.

establishing_shot.camera_note: Frame the 7-Eleven facade, forecourt canopy, clue marker, and far-side traffic before the player gets control.

major_fights.title: Forecourt Fuel Islands
major_fights.completion_note: Fuel-island bollards create readable cover; no explosive hazard can soft-lock the walk lane.

major_fights.title: Madison Plaza Layers
major_fights.completion_note: Carl's Jr. depth layer, plaza storefront band, and distant road layer remain separate so the lot reads in 2.5D.

major_fights.title: I-8 Ramp Shadow
major_fights.completion_note: The underpass ends with a tonal shift to concrete, water reflection, ramp noise, and a clean camera exit.

ambush_or_optional.title: Recessed Threshold Cache
ambush_or_optional.reward: health snack, Chief command charge, and score bonus
ambush_or_optional.risk: a recessed storefront keeps the camera tighter while a whip specialist guards the return line

environmental_events.description: Fuel islands and bollards bend approach lines while preserving a visible safe route around every obstacle.
A smoking tent row under the plaza awning spills new fighters into the lane before the underpass shadow.
Ramp traffic shadows, concrete pillars, and a passing headlight sweep increase pressure as the party enters I-8.

story_beats.description: The party confirms Couch's trail at the 7-Eleven exterior before the forecourt fight begins.

landmark_set_pieces.description: The playable route ends inside the underpass shadow with creek edge, retaining wall, columns, and roadway sound.

traversal_gaps.description: Driveways, service bays, and a ramp merge create a short layered traversal segment with visible warning arrows.

ending.visual: The camera pulls past the last I-8 column into a limited travel montage.
ending.narrative: The crew crosses the shadow toward the 690 showroom and fuel row before Soapy Joe's.

establishing_shot.camera_note: Open on the white wash structure, vivid blue roof band, palms, wet pavement, and repeating vacuum arches.

major_fights.title: Soapy Joe's Front Lot
major_fights.completion_note: Wash foam, wet reflections, and moving canopy lights remain visual dressing with collision-safe boundaries.

major_fights.title: Broadway Turn Pressure
major_fights.completion_note: The major fight turns the camera with the intersection, so Broadway feels like a route change rather than a backdrop swap.

major_fights.title: Revive Pathway Final Push
major_fights.completion_note: The cleared pathway points to Awaken with an explicit route card instead of an unexplained mission jump.

ambush_or_optional.title: Boot Shop Loading Bay
ambush_or_optional.reward: temporary score multiplier, weapon pickup, and a revive snack
ambush_or_optional.risk: a short side arena with a bruiser and limited dodge space

environmental_events.description: Reflective runoff, canopy light sweeps, and soap foam add motion without creating hidden hazards or muddy collision.
A cramped tent line by the service lane smokes up and coughs new bodies into the Broadway turn.
A traffic-signal cycle and passing vehicle light turn the CVS corner into a readable directional change.

story_beats.description: A final clue at Revive reframes the Awaken lot as Couch's chosen stage and prepares the BMX reveal.

landmark_set_pieces.description: The CVS corner, street sign, receding Broadway storefronts, and Revive medical-office massing explain the lateral turn.

traversal_gaps.description: A drive-through lane, curb ramp, and crossing traffic create an authored pace break before the Broadway turn.

ending.visual: Revive signage falls behind as the route card tracks north-west toward the Awaken lot.
ending.narrative: The chapter turns personal: Couch is waiting by Dave's BMX.

establishing_shot.camera_note: Reveal the Awaken facade, lit front lot, Couch's silhouette, and Dave's BMX at x=1080 before the confrontation closes in.

major_fights.title: Awaken Arrival Scouts
major_fights.completion_note: The group clears enough space for the Awaken facade and BMX story prop to become readable.

major_fights.title: Awaken Lot Intercept
major_fights.completion_note: Couch watches from the BMX line and does not become damageable until the lot intercept is cleared.

major_fights.title: Couch at Awaken
major_fights.completion_note: Couch's two BMX retreats force crew clears before the final damage window; neither retreat can skip the next phase.

ambush_or_optional.title: BMX Lockup Cache
ambush_or_optional.reward: Chief meter refill and a life-saving snack before the boss lock
ambush_or_optional.risk: a short side-lot ambush can drain health before Couch begins

environmental_events.description: A floodlight sweep, gate rattle, and parked-bike shine make the confrontation feel staged without hiding player silhouettes.
A final tent cluster smokes behind the south lot and lets the last camp fighters crawl into the approach lane.
Couch's jump arc travels to the actual BMX refuge marker, preserving collision and showing why she is temporarily unreachable.

story_beats.description: Couch identifies the BMX, mocks the party, and escalates through two crew bargains before the final defeat.

landmark_set_pieces.description: The church facade, front-lot median, single BMX marker, and sunset end strip carry the finale's geography.

traversal_gaps.description: Players move around the front-lot median before the boss lock; it is a readable depth-navigation moment, not a permanent block.

ending.visual: The crew reunites beside Dave's BMX under a sunset lot silhouette before the results screen.
ending.narrative: The Chapter 1 victory beat resolves the chase while leaving the road open for the next route.

inter_level_travel.heading: EL CILANTRO TO 7-ELEVEN
beats: Jerry's clue holds on the northbound road arrow.
A short moving panorama carries the party past Madison without a silent teleport.

inter_level_travel.heading: I-8 TO SOAPY JOE'S
beats: The party crosses the I-8 shadow past the 690 showroom shell.
The fuel corridor and smog row pass in a non-combat moving montage before Soapy Joe's appears.

inter_level_travel.heading: REVIVE TO AWAKEN
beats: Broadway street signs and the route turn point toward the Awaken lot.
The final approach lets the BMX and facade appear before Couch gets her opening line.

phases.objective: Fight Couch in the front lot until the first health gate; Couch remains targetable.
Clear Couch's first fictional road-raider crew, then bring her back from the BMX to resume the fight.

retreat.taunt: I'LL GIVE YOU DOPE IF YOU BEAT THEM UP!

phases.objective: Clear a larger second fictional road-raider crew, then finish Couch after she returns from the BMX.

retreat.taunt: I'LL GIVE YOU DOPE IF YOU BEAT THEM UP!
